dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.sub: Platform health, control-plane counts and recent audited activity across all four planes.
dashboard.unreachableNote: Unreachable = service not started in this dev environment; dependent views fall back to marked dev seeds.

applications.title: Applications
applications.sub: Service registry: all 15 core services plus plane applications. Enable/disable controls health polling and route eligibility.

rulePacks.title: Rule Packs
rulePacks.sub: All rp-* packs from the rule-pack registry: status, provenance, signature, publish ceremony and stale-consumer alerts.
rulePacks.staleConsumers: Stale consumers pinned to old versions: {{list}}
rulePacks.publishConfirm: Publish {{id}}@{{ver}}? This is a board-authorised ceremony action (nrs.rulepacks.published.v1).

gates.title: Gates & Reg-watch
gates.sub: Regulatory gates are board-authorised switches. Flips are armed, confirmed and audited. Gazette watch tracks the instruments behind each gate.
gates.flipWarn: Gate flips are board-authorised and written to the append-only audit trail. You are about to {{action}} <1>{{id}}</1>.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.sub: TigerBeetle double-entry scheme (integer kobo only). Accounts browser, balance lookup, transfer initiation and PSSP recon breaks.
ledger.transferNote: Creates a pending (authorise) transfer. Post or void via the ledger service; float accounts enforce DEBITS_MUST_NOT_EXCEED_CREDITS.
ledger.pendingCreated: Pending transfer {{id}} created — post or void it from the ledger svc (code 1=authorise).

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.sub: wf-* registry across planes. Triggers run via temporal-sdkx; with TEMPORAL_URL unset the dev in-process runner executes them and runs are audited.
workflows.inputHint: Valid JSON object passed to the workflow run.

audit.title: Audit & Evidence (WORM)
audit.sub: Append-only audit trail, write-once-read-many evidence objects with in-browser sha256 verification (WebCrypto), and technical-audit-trail assembly.
audit.tatSummary: Who saw what, when, under which rule pack — {{count}} entries
audit.hashFail: HASH MISMATCH — do not trust this object

tenants.title: Tenants & Identity
tenants.sub: Tenant isolation levels (enclave / schema / row), console users & roles, and Permify relationship tuples.
tenants.name: Name

flows.title: Cross-Zone Flows
flows.sub: F1–F10 matrix from the unified architecture. All cross-zone traffic passes the audited enclave-gateway with synchronous WORM receipts; F9/F10 are forbidden by construction.
flows.forbiddenClean: Clean — no sightings. This monitor must always be empty; any sighting is a security incident.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: Edge policy & WAF mode, notification providers, feature flags and API keys.
settings.wafFailed: WAF mode change failed (requires admin role)
settings.notifNote: All providers run behind interfaces with log simulators in dev (honesty tag: no real SMS/email is sent).
settings.keyPlaceholder: key name e.g. ci ceremony bot

login.subtitle: Meridian Management Console — Platform Operations
login.footer: Sovereign tax infrastructure · two zones · audited cross-zone flows only
